Package jzelda.model

Class GameModel

java.lang.Object
jzelda.patterns.AbstractObservableModel
jzelda.model.GameModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
ObservableModel
public class GameModel extends AbstractObservableModel
Core game model in the MVC architecture. It owns the full game state: current profile, levels, entities, score, lives, rupees, inventory, shop, leaderboard and progression. The view observes it but does not change internal state directly.
